facts.text: The Pakistani section of the highway officially starts at Hasan Abdal, 50 km northwest of Rawalpindi, while the Chinese section starts from Kashgar.
facts.quote: officially starts from Hasan Abdal, 50 km (31 mi) northwest of Rawalpindi

facts.text: The usual jumping-off point for the highway is Gilgit, and you can take a PIA flight from Islamabad to Gilgit.
facts.quote: usual jumping off point is Gilgit

facts.text: From Rawalpindi, a bus journey to Hasan Abdal may take not more than 1 hour.
facts.quote: A bus journey from Rawalpindi may take not more than 1 hr.

facts.text: The most used method of travel is hopping on to vans, which is affordable and convenient.
facts.quote: most used method is hopping on to vans

facts.text: The border is not open for cyclists; from the Pakistani side you can cycle up to the pass but not over it and must return to Sost to take the bus.
facts.quote: The border is not open for cyclists.

facts.text: In some narrow places, only one vehicle can pass at a time while the other waits on the narrow edge of the road.
facts.quote: only one vehicle can pass at a time

facts.text: The Khunjerab Pass is closed from January through to April due to heavy snow.
facts.quote: closed from January through to April due to heavy snow

facts.text: Landslides that can block the road for hours or more are common at some places during the monsoon season (Jul-Sep).
facts.quote: Landslides that can block the road for hours or more are common at some places during the monsoon season (Jul-Sep).

facts.text: The Karakoram Highway is best travelled in the spring or early autumn.
facts.quote: best travelled in the spring or early autumn

facts.text: If you wish to cross borders using the highway, get the visa of the other country beforehand; otherwise entry at the border will not be granted.
facts.quote: get the visa of the other country beforehand

facts.text: Entry will not be granted to those on cycles.
facts.quote: Entry will not be granted to those on cycles.

facts.text: The Wakhan Corridor has neither good roads nor border posts where one could legally enter China or Pakistan.
facts.quote: neither good roads nor border posts where one could legally enter China or Pakistan

facts.text: Mind altitude sickness; carry an oxygen mask if you have chronic respiratory conditions or when you feel unwell.
facts.quote: carry an oxygen mask if you have chronic respiratory conditions

facts.text: Some parts of the highway are very hot during summer; the temperature can reach 45°C (113°F).
Carry a first aid kit just in case of an accident.
facts.quote: Carry a first aid kit just in case of an accident

facts.text: The more you go north, the safer it becomes, especially between Gilgit and the border pass.
facts.quote: The more you go north, the safer it becomes

facts.text: Many countries advise against all travel on the highway between Mansehra and Chilas due to poor road safety.
facts.quote: advise against all travel on the highway between Mansehra and Chilas
